name: It Paints Me
source:
Every night, you awaken in your studio and paint your masterpiece. 

Or, at least, you try to.

[i]Oh,[/i] if only your muse would return.

[i]If only lifting your brush didn't fill your fingertips with agony.[/i]

[From [url=https://endysis.itch.io/it-paints-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每天晚上，你都会在工作室中醒来并绘制你的杰作。

或者，至少，你尝试这样做。

[i]哦，[/i]如果你的缪斯能回来就好了。

[i]如果只是举起画笔，指尖不会充满痛苦就好了。[/i]

[来自[url=https://endysis.itch.io/it-paints-me]itch.io[/url]]
